Example 5 Which term of the G.P., 2,8,32, ... up to n terms is 131072?
Solution Let 131072 be the nth term of the given G.P. Here a = 2 and r = 4.
Therefore
131072 = an = 2(4)n – 1
or
65536 = 4n – 1
This gives
48 = 4n – 1.
So that n – 1 = 8, i.e., n = 9. Hence, 131072 is the 9th term of  the G.P.
